2609.26704.title: Beyond Repeated Sampling: Learning Search Policies for LLM Reasoning
2609.26704.paper_summary: Large language models increasingly tackle hard reasoning problems by spending more test-time compute, yet the dominant strategy remains naive repeated sampling: draw many independent solutions and hope one is correct. Because such sampling explores only through local decoding noise, it tends to produce many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. We ask whether exploration can instead be steered at a semantic level, by first sampling problem specific concepts, hints, or strategies and then conditioning answer generation on them. We refine this into a simple, more exploratory procedure that emits many diverse concepts in a single trajectory, and evaluate it on hard problems where repeated sampling struggles. We then go a step further and make concept generation trainable: a small concept generator is optimized with reinforcement learning so that its concepts maximize the downstream success of a larger, frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical reasoning problems, the trained concept generator substantially improves the answer generator's pass@k over naive repeated sampling at the same answer generation allocation, surpasses concepts drawn from much larger untuned models, and transfers to answer generators it was never trained against, including a model from a different family. A small model can thus be trained into an effective, reusable search policy for a much larger one.
2609.26704.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地通過增加測試時間的計算來解決困難的推理問題，但主導策略仍然是天真的重複抽樣：抽取許多獨立的解決方案，並希望其中一個是正確的。由於這種抽樣僅通過局部解碼噪音進行探索，因此往往會產生許多近似重複的嘗試，而不是實質上不同的想法。我們詢問是否可以在語義層面上引導探索，首先抽取問題特定的概念、提示或策略，然後基於這些進行答案生成。我們將這一點精煉為一個簡單的、更具探索性的程序，該程序在單一軌跡中產生許多多樣化的概念，並在重複抽樣困難的問題上對其進行評估。然後，我們更進一步，使概念生成可訓練：一個小型概念生成器通過強化學習進行優化，以便其概念最大化較大、固定的答案生成器的下游成功。在困難的數學推理問題上，訓練後的概念生成器顯著提高了答案生成器在相同答案生成分配下的 pass@k，超越了從更大未調整模型中抽取的概念，並且能轉移到從未針對其訓練過的答案生成器，包括來自不同家族的模型。因此，一個小型模型可以被訓練成為一個有效的、可重用的搜索策略，為一個更大的模型服務。
